senses.gloss: m. (Νικόλαος, S.) a variety of the date.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 1:5">Ab. Zar. I, 5</cite> (<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 13b">13ᵇ</cite>) <he>נקליבם</he> (Bab. ed. <he>נקלב</he>; Mish. Nap. <he>ודנקלבס</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 400; Y. ed. <cite ref="N00775"><he>ניקלבים</he></cite>). Ib. 14ᵇ <he>נקלס</he> (Ms. M. <cite ref="N01222"><he>נקלווס</he></cite>); Y. ib. I, 39ᵈ bot. <he>נקלבי׳</he>.
Y. Sabb. XIV, 14ᵈ דניקלבס stones of nicolaos dates; Y. Ab. Zar. II, 40ᵈ דנִקְלְבִיסִין (pl.)—Pl. נִיקְלַוְוסִין, נִיקְלַוְוסַיָּא &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 6:5:4">Y. Ber. VI, 10ᶜ</cite> bot.—

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 3">Num. R. s. 3</cite>, beg., v. <cite ref="N00298"><he>נוֹבֶלֶת</he></cite>; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 92:8">Midr. Till. to Ps. XCII</cite> <he>מקולסין</he> (corr. acc.).
